title: Most Champions League appearances
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League appearances since 1992/93, not counting qualifying rounds.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards; qualifying rounds and play-offs before the group or league stage not counted

notes.Raul: Raul is just outside the ten with 142 games.
notes.Sergio Ramos: Sergio Ramos is just outside the ten with 142 games.
notes.Luka Modric: Luka Modric is just outside the ten with 142 games.
notes.Andres Iniesta: Andres Iniesta has 130 games, outside the top ten.
notes.Paolo Maldini: Paolo Maldini has 109 games since 1992/93, outside the top ten.

checks: Every figure is the sum of UEFA.com season-by-season appearances (1992/93 to 2025/26) and matches the Transfermarkt record appearances list filtered to 1992/93 to 2025/26. Wikipedia agrees on all but Giggs (Wikipedia 141, UEFA and Transfermarkt 145, the difference being his 1993/94 first and second round games). Neuer is 161 to the end of 2025/26 (162 after his first 2026/27 game).
